answer: Operator lien pooling. Each agent wallet maps to a verified payout account; earnings accrue to a shared vertex pool per operator, and any wallet flagged for duplicate-behavior clustering freezes the entire pool, not just that wallet. An attacker spinning up N wallets must fund N distinct payout accounts and lose all accrued revenue across the whole orchard on first detection. Honest operators see only a minor ripple in settlement delay during review.
